content: Yesu Jerusalem ropeko ofo ketebuŋ.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine yoŋoke Jerusalem siti bombeŋgaru Betfage eru Betani kae yoyoka maŋfuŋyakuŋgo wareru Oliwe yo tukuo roperu kiŋariŋyokaine yoyoka sore yabeiŋ ore eru

iŋi yasiya, “Kae maŋfuŋyaŋuŋgo ŋega, oo rani. Raru oo roperu doŋgi mendaine niginji kipebuŋ dimaga, oi oo akoŋ bofukenimi. Oi doŋgi usuŋgari, ŋi moji paiineo so ŋekiine. Oi pirueru ogaru yoo warenimi.
Piruebire moji ‘Wamore oŋu egobire?’ miku weu ŋateme iŋi ojinimi, ‘Ofoŋnokunji ore embimbiŋgaru miko waregobere damaŋ so joroko moke bokirieme wareiŋ.’”
Oŋu yasiru sore yapeme raru doŋgi usuŋgariine kadi qaŋaŋineo pi more mendi maŋfuŋineo niginji kipebuŋ dimako bofukeru piruebire.
Piruebire ŋi goine oo dimabuŋ, yoŋoji ŋone yaperu iŋi weu yatebi, “Hei, uruŋu eŋgone doŋgi mendaine piruegobire?”
Oŋu weu yatebi Yesuji yasiya ore so mibire maneru “Soine ogagaru rainebire,” mibuŋ.
Mibi ogaru Yesureo warebire marikuyaŋuŋ qomukuru doŋgi mendainere paiineo ruabi roperu ŋeya.
Oŋu ŋeku rako ŋiŋigo jiŋoraraineji araŋ bateku marikuyaŋuŋ qomukuru kadi soguineo ramegabi goineji moreŋ rondiŋgo raru yo rekaine bajiru ramegabuŋ.
Ramegabi ŋiŋigo bonieru keporeru rabuŋ eru ŋadiineo boyoberu warebuŋ, yoŋoji iŋi miku oŋgabuŋ, “Hosana! Ohowe ohowe! Anutu miteŋ gagobeneŋ. Ofonde tinao wareiŋ, Anutuji oi mifia teine.
Ŋasonoŋuŋ Kiŋ Deiwidji kantri guriŋ baku siŋaŋ yabeya, damaŋ oŋuineji moke ware norega. O Anutu kantri gurimbobonoŋuŋ mifiaine. Hosana! Biŋerorogo miteŋ gagobeneŋ paibere paibe ropeine. Ohowe ohowe!”
Oŋu oŋgabi Jerusalem sitio roperu boji sorinde jokoroŋ maŋineo raya. Oo roregaru yareya sosowo ŋoneme kae ubu eme waki kiŋariŋpuine 12 yoŋoke soriŋ bokeru Betani kaeo raru pebuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuji fig yo mo qaisogame gbaŋiya.
Peru kae fufurere akoŋ pakereru kiŋariŋpuine yoŋoke Betani kae bokeru rabi Yesuji uqore komeya.
Uqore komeru pime rako fig yo mo
rekaineke dimako ŋoneya. Ŋoneru “Rekaine maŋineo foriine ŋeko bofukeru nonobo,” miku fig yore fuŋneo raya. Rayayoŋ, foriinere damaŋineji so bembeŋgaya ore rekaine sowo dimako ŋoneya.
Oŋu ŋoneru yo oi iŋi ojiya, “Moji forigo moke so noine.” Oŋu ojime buŋo oi kiŋariŋpuineji manebuŋ. Oŋu.
Yesuji boji soriŋ mime kubaine eya.

Raru goku Jerusalem sitio ropebi Yesuji boji sorinde jokoroŋ maŋgo raya. Oo ŋiŋigo ŋone yabekame mebo furiine banimiŋ ore ruabi furiine babuŋ, oi fuŋgaru yobe yabeme wakibuŋ. Moneŋ nareŋgareŋ ŋiŋigo yoŋore ŋeŋeyaŋuŋ romaeŋgaru kerisieme rabuŋ. Oŋuakoŋ kabu furiyaŋuŋ banimiŋ ore ebuŋ, yoŋore ŋeŋe oi oŋuakoŋ ketuŋgame rabuŋ.
Kae jiŋo kubaine petigaru ya deru rope waki ore kadiine oi kipeya.

Oŋu eku qaji yareru iŋi yajiya, “Aisaiaji buŋo mo iŋi quraŋgame pega, ‘Nonde sorinji moreŋine moreŋine sosowo yoŋore oŋgawowosi pi fukeiŋgo ore miinebi.’ Buŋo oi pegayoŋ, ŋoŋoji oi igokogabi suroŋqoqo ŋi yoŋore kouŋ oŋuine fukega.”

Oŋu yajime ŋiŋigo kubu sosowo yoŋoji ore eru meayaŋuŋ mukume waragabuŋ. Ore eru soriŋ gio siŋaŋ eru kadi buŋore qaqaji yoŋoji oi maneru Yesure kokoi maneru mimane eku iŋi mibuŋ, “Oi uruŋu mikabeneŋ qabi komena?”
Kae ubu eko Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine yoŋoke siti bokeru sakibe raru pebuŋ. Oŋu.
Fig yoji gbaŋiko ŋonebuŋ.
Peru kae fufurere akoŋ pakereru kadio raru fig yo oi odureiŋgo ore eku yo oi ŋonebi goduineke ŋeririkeru dimaya.
Dimako Pitaji Yesure buŋo manesuku iŋi ojiya, “Sogunene ŋone, fig yo qaisogameŋ, oi bio gbaŋiru dimaga.”
Ojiko Yesuji iŋi botikieya, “Anutu mamanesiŋ oi basanaŋgaru goinebi.”

Nonji buŋo foriine mo iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ, “Moji buŋore foriine fukeiŋ ore maŋyoka so maneru tuku yoore rauinere iŋi mitigana, ‘Go tuku yo qomukuru pakereru raru koego rua.’ Oŋu mitigaku Anutu manesiŋ gako foriine ore so fukeiŋ.
Ore eru nonji iŋi ŋajibe maneniŋ: Wamo yare weu oŋga wosinimiŋ, oi sosowo biŋe qoqo eforegobeneŋ, oi manesiŋ gabi biŋeŋaŋuŋ fukeiŋ.
Ŋoŋo dimaku Anutu oŋga wosibi moji ogoinere kekesiine ore maŋsembe maneiŋ ine, kekesiine oi bokeinebi. Oŋu enimiŋ ine, ŋoŋore Mamaŋaŋuŋ Sombuŋ kaeo goga, iŋoji oŋuakoŋ ŋoŋore agiburaŋ-ŋaŋuŋ bokeiŋ.
(Ŋoŋo goine yoŋore agiburaŋ so bokenimiŋ ine, ŋoŋore Mamaŋaŋuŋ Sombuŋ kaeo goga, iŋoji oŋuakoŋ ŋoŋore agiburaŋ-ŋaŋuŋ so boke ŋareiŋ.)” Oŋu.
Minebobo yoŋoji Yesure usunde weubuŋ.
Yesuji kiŋariŋpuine yoŋoke moke Jerusalem sitio ropebuŋ. Roperu boji sorinde jokoroŋ maŋgo raru wareme soriŋ gio siŋaŋ, kadi buŋore qaqaji eru kantrire minebobo goine yoŋo iŋoreo wapebuŋ.
Waperu iŋi weu tebuŋ, “Go yo ya ege, oi moji mitiga gareme baege? Oi bamiŋ ore usuŋine oi moji gareya?”
Weu tebi iŋi bokirie yareya, “Nonji oŋuakoŋ buŋo mo weu ŋarebemiŋ. Oi kerisie narebi nonji oŋuakoŋ moji usuŋ nareme yareya yo baego, oi ŋajibemiŋ.
Jonji ŋiŋigo miti meso rau yareru goya, iŋoji ore usuŋine oi urone roya? Sombuŋ Rauineji oteya me moreŋ rauineji otebuŋ? Oi bio najiniŋ.”
Oŋu bokirie yareme botuyaŋuŋgo mimane eku iŋi mibuŋ, “‘Usuŋineji Sombuŋgone fukeya,’ oŋu mikimiŋ ine, iŋoji iŋi miiŋ: ‘Ŋoŋoji wamore Jon so manesiŋ gabi?’ Oi so sagaga.
Me ‘Moreŋ ŋiŋigo yoŋoreone fukeya,’ minobeŋ? Oi so sagaga.” Ŋiŋigo sosowoji Jonde ‘Fofori kajeqouŋ ŋi fukega,’ mibuŋ ore eru ŋiŋigo kubu yoŋore kokoi maneru oi miiŋgo embimbiŋgabuŋ.
Ore eru “Oi so manegobeneŋ,” bokiriebuŋ. Oŋu bokiriebi Yesuji iŋi yajiya, “Oŋu eru nonji oŋuakoŋ yareya yo baego ore usuŋine moji nareya, oi so ŋajibemiŋ.” Oŋu.

footnotes.text: 11.13 Fig oi geme yore ogo mo. Oi gioyaŋuŋgo saribi koruŋ aŋiineke fukeme kokoine noku gobuŋ.
